blocks.title: Compilers
blocks.text: Compilers are translators that convert entire programs from high-level languages into machine code before execution. Their purpose is to optimize the code and convert it into efficient machine code.

items: GCC: the GNU Compiler Collection for C and C++.
javac: the compiler for Java programs.

blocks.prompt: When does a compiler translate a program, and what does it produce?
blocks.explanation: Before the program is executed, all at once; it produces efficient machine code that the computer can run directly.

items: Compilers: translate the whole program to efficient machine code before execution; GCC (C/C++), javac (Java).
